prompt.en: Which province does the guide call Canada's largest producer of grains and oilseeds?
prompt.fr: Quelle province le guide présente-t-il comme le plus grand producteur de céréales et d'oléagineux au Canada?

explanation.en: The guide names Saskatchewan as the country's largest producer of grains and oilseeds. It was once known as the wheat province.
explanation.fr: Le guide présente la Saskatchewan comme le plus grand producteur de céréales et d'oléagineux du pays. On l'a déjà appelée la province du blé.

source.quote: Saskatchewan, once known as the “breadbasket of the world” and the “wheat province,” has 40% of the arable land in Canada and is the country’s largest producer of grains and oilseeds.

verification.evidence: Saskatchewan, once known as the “breadbasket of the world” and the “wheat province,” … is the country’s largest producer of grains and oilseeds.
